title: A Journey leader can email the people enrolled in it, through the Space email lane

source.ref: Meta scan 2026-10-26 (audits/meta-scan-2026-10-26.md), Phase 4 follow-up: Journeys email to a cohort was a disabled chip

detail: The Email chip in Message enrollees on /journeys/[slug]/launch was disabled. It now sends through the Space's own campaign lane: a campaigns row under the marketing topic, then sendSpaceCampaign with a journey:<planId>[:in_progress|:finished] member segment, so the kill switch, daily cap, monthly meter, suppression and one-click unsubscribe all apply. The segment is re-resolved on the server and only when the plan belongs to that Space. It reaches enrolled people the Space already holds a subscribed contact for (ADR-863: an account email is never read for a Space send), so the result line can be smaller than the enrolled count. A Journey with no Space keeps a disabled chip that says so. Dispatch to a cohort stays a separate follow-up.

verify.note: Exits 0 once the launch action sends email through the Space campaign lane with a journey member segment.
